question: In an election between two candidates, 80% of the registered voters cast their vote and 5% of the votes polled were found invalid. The winning candidate got 75% of the valid votes and won the election by a margin of 1805 votes. How many voters were registered?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the total registered voters be 100x.

Votes cast = 80% of 100x = 80x, Valid votes = 95% of 80x = 76x.

Winner gets 75% of valid votes ⇒ Loser gets 25% of valid votes.

Winning Margin = (75% − 25%) = 50% of valid votes.

Margin = 50% of 76x = 38x = 1805 ⇒ x = 1805 ÷ 38 = 47.5

**∴ The correct answer is 4750.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage of registered voters who cast their vote = 80%

Percentage of invalid votes = 5% of cast votes

Winner gets 75% of valid votes and wins by 1805 votes.

 
 
 Registered: 100x
